verdict.line: You lose if you facetank her Q-into-W stun before level 3; you win if you poke with E at range and punish her dash cooldowns in extended trades.

brief.thesis: Volibear's E (Sky Splitter) has 1200 range, which outranges every tool Riven owns — her longest ability, Q (Broken Wings), only reaches 275. That forces her to spend dash charges just to get in auto range while he chips freely and shields himself if he stands in the blast. Combined with W's self-heal and R's bonus health, Volibear is built to win attrition rather than trade cooldown-for-cooldown, which is why the 51.9% head-to-head over 823 games sits well above his 48.9% average top-lane win rate.

theirWindow.when: When her Q and E are both up
theirWindow.what: She can chain Q's dash strikes into W (Ki Burst)'s stun at close range and start stacking Conqueror off the follow-up autos. Don't stand still for it — back off or let her burn charges into a minion.

yourWindow.what: She has no damage-block dash to escape or soak your engage. Lead with Q (Thundering Smash) for the stun, then double-tap W (Frenzied Maul) on the mark for the bonus damage and heal — she can't disengage.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Highest pick rate (67.8%) and win rate (53.8% over 684 games) in this matchup — the mana sustain lets you spam E to poke across her short dash range without running dry.

boots.why: 52.6% win rate and the clear majority pick (62.8%) — flattens the burst from her Runic Blade-charged autos when she finally closes the gap.

core.why: First item in the highest-sample core path (56% WR, 11.8% pick) into Navori Flickerblade / Spirit Visage.
Attack speed and cooldown refund compound with your passive's on-hit magic damage and let W's recast come up faster in extended trades.
Boosts the heal on your W recast, which is the sustain tool that wins the attrition war this matchup is built around.

situational.when: she's stacking Conqueror and healing hard off her on-hit damage in trades
skirmishes are dragging past her first all-in and you need the extra damage reduction to out-sustain her
the enemy team is loaded with hard CC or AP burst beyond just Riven

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking attack speed rewards grinding out the extended trade rather than winning one burst window, which lines up with how this matchup is actually won — W recasts and autos, not a single all-in.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite is the standard pick (65.9% pick rate, 53.8% WR) and secures the solo kill off a landed Q stun. Flash + Exhaust posts the best raw win rate in the data (56.7% over 22.5% pick) by directly neutering her Q-W all-in damage and Conqueror healing if she's ahead.

playing.title: Open with E poke
playing.detail: Your skill order starts on E. Use its 1200 range to chip her down before she can close with her 275-range Q strikes, and stand in the blast yourself for the shield if she tries to force it.

playing.title: Punish Valor cooldowns
playing.detail: Her E (Valor) is her only damage-block and extra gap-close. When it's down she has nothing left to escape your engage — commit with Q into double W.

playing.title: Track her stack count
playing.detail: Watch her Conqueror stacks before committing to a long trade. If she's fully stacked, disengage instead of grinding it out face to face.

playing.title: Save R to punish dives
playing.detail: Stormbringer's bonus health and slow swing extended skirmishes in your favor, and the temporary tower disable lets you force a turret dive once you're ahead.

playing.title: Respect level 1-2 all-ins
playing.detail: Before your W sustain comes online, don't trade face-to-face into her dash-into-stun combo. Poke with E and auto when she's out of Q charges instead.

playing.title: End fights fast past level 11
playing.detail: Her R cooldown drops as low as 10s at higher ranks, letting her re-trigger Blade of the Exile and Wind Slash almost on demand. Win the skirmish in one or two kit rotations rather than grinding a long fight.

playing.title: Rush Thornmail if she's healing
playing.detail: If her Conqueror stacks and on-hit sustain are keeping her topped up through your trades, buy Thornmail earlier than the standard build path to shut it down.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate/sample numbers are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning, timing windows, and tell-reading are my own analysis, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep an eye out for Riven’s Conqueror stacks before fighting her. Purchase Bramble Vest, and use [Q][E] combo to gain the upper hand in combat.
